meta.instruction: The player's chosen Primary Attribute (STR, DEX, or INT) determines their starting civilization and quest line.
meta.usage: Ingest the specific key matching the player's stat to retrieve the narrative path.

quests.title: The Inspection Gambit
quests.narrative_guidance: Corvess's network requires forged Syndicate inspection papers to maintain the station's autonomy and keep the Chorus's secrets buried.
improvisation_points: Recover the template from the Shredder pits in Foundry Maw.
Take the template to Signal-Eater Lane to have it digitally encoded.
Deliver the final forged documents to the Crow's Nest for distribution.

quests.title: The Plasma Run
quests.narrative_guidance: Lira Voidhand demands a rare shipment of quantum plasma rods be smuggled through the dark zones to fuel her black market power.
improvisation_points: Secure the plasma shipment from the Dead-Air Market.
Route the rods through the high-voltage Spark-Gap to mask their signature.
Drop the rods into the Sump for final pickup and payment.

quests.title: Relic of the Thicket
quests.narrative_guidance: Brother Hask begs for the recovery of a stolen relic idol, claiming it holds the spiritual essence needed to stabilize the hydroponic bunkers.
improvisation_points: Locate the idol's trail in the Condensate Thicket.
Retrieve the idol from the heavy-lift zones of The Sledge.
Return the idol to the Navigator’s Rest for a ritual purification.

quests.title: Contract Cleanup
quests.narrative_guidance: Tovin Grell needs a rival mercenary team eliminated before they can outbid the Chorus on a lucrative station-wide contract.
improvisation_points: Identify the rival's heat signature near the Heat-Sink Spire.
Lure them into an ambush at Pressure-Lock 4.
Confirm the elimination to the lookout at Wire-Walk.

quests.title: The Cipher Protocol
quests.narrative_guidance: Cipher-Iron requires help in delivering a forbidden data package through the station's arterial network without alerting the Warlords.
improvisation_points: Acquire the data drive hidden in The Leak.
Corrode the drive's security lock in Rust-Gully.
Upload the data to the central hydraulic processor in Piston Row.

quests.title: The Injector Prototype
quests.narrative_guidance: Jax Orlin needs scavenged tech components from across the Chorus's territory to complete his experimental fuel injector.
improvisation_points: Scavenge rare alloys from the Slag Flats.
Obtain a high-flow fan from The Vent.
Assemble the prototype in the Ghost Docks.

quests.title: Herald's Sacrifice
quests.narrative_guidance: The Crimson Herald demands a demonstration of loyalty through the strategic sabotage of a secondary fuel tank to prove the Chorus's might.
improvisation_points: Collect caustic minerals from the Copper-Crawl.
Use the minerals to breach the tank at The Fuel-Well.
Commemorate the destruction at The Anvil with a blood-mark.

quests.title: The Paper Trail Protocol
quests.narrative_guidance: Corvess needs forged Syndicate inspection papers moved across the station to hide the fuel guild's secret reserves.
improvisation_points: Retrieve the blank forms from Twitch in Flicker Alley.
Have the forms encrypted with the fake Syndicate seal by Code in the Cipher Cellar.
Deliver the final papers to Drift at the Drift Deck for distribution.

quests.title: Quantum Plasma Rod Run
quests.narrative_guidance: Lira Voidhand requires a shipment of quantum plasma rods smuggled from the scrap heaps to her private market.
improvisation_points: Meet Vex in the Vector Void to receive the shipment coordinates.
Pick up the rods from Junk in the Scrap Sift while avoiding patrols.
Deliver the rods to Alta at the Pilot's Perch for safe storage.

quests.title: The Lost Relic Search
quests.narrative_guidance: A sacred relic idol has been lost in the station's heavy machinery and must be recovered for the sanctuary.
improvisation_points: Obtain the last known location of the idol from Piston in Hydraulic Heights.
Search for the hidden idol near the Shadow Spire with Spire's guidance.
Return the idol to Grip in Gasket Grove for purification and storage.

quests.title: Market Contract Clean-up
quests.narrative_guidance: A rival mercenary team is encroaching on Tovin Grell's territory. You must disrupt their supply lines.
improvisation_points: Get the target roster and route from Dash at The Rivet Run.
Use Haze's jamming equipment in the Sensor Shroud to disable their comms.
Report the success to Gauge in the Precision Pit to claim the bounty.

quests.title: The Forbidden Data Hand-off
quests.narrative_guidance: A high-security data package from Cipher-Iron must be delivered across the station without Syndicate detection.
improvisation_points: Receive the encrypted drive from Wire in Whisper Wire.
Route the data through Static's interceptor in the Signal Snag to scrub the signature.
Finalize the delivery to Core in the Hollow Hub for transmission.

quests.title: The Injector Prototype
quests.narrative_guidance: Jax Orlin needs specialized alien tech to complete his experimental fuel injector prototype.
improvisation_points: Consult Spark in Micro-Weld Row for the technical specifications.
Find the rare alien circuit board in Glint's Null Gallery.
Deliver the components to Melt at the Flux Foundry to begin the casting process.

quests.title: Siphon Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: A statement must be made. The Fuel Tank Array needs to be subtly sabotaged to distract the Warlord's guards.
improvisation_points: Get the sabotage instructions from Ghost in the False Bulkhead District.
Navigate the Cloak Walk with Shade to plant the disruptors undetected.
Meet with Blind at The Blind Spot to confirm the perimeter is clear before the blast.

quests.title: The Forged Inspection
quests.narrative_guidance: Secure the station's independence by distributing forged Syndicate papers through the black market.
improvisation_points: Meet Jax Orlin at Hangar-Prime to receive the forged documents.
Deliver the papers to Marek Vyke for official stamping at Docking Bay 9.
Confirm the documents have cleared the market with Zola Silt.

quests.title: The Plasma Heist
quests.narrative_guidance: Smuggle a crate of quantum plasma rods past the internal security sensors.
improvisation_points: Acquire the rods from Cipher-Iron under the Helium-3 Siphon.
Have Tully Moss hide the rods in a shipment of condensate.
Deliver the rods to Sister Elara at the Sleeper Pods for safe keeping.

quests.title: The Crimson Path
quests.narrative_guidance: Demonstrate loyalty by marking specific logic-nodes with the Herald's signs.
improvisation_points: Receive the ritual markings from The Crimson Herald.
Smear the markings on the main terminal held by Node-7.
Report the completed ritual to Exo-Link.

quests.title: Memory Retrieval
quests.narrative_guidance: Recover stolen memory cores from the district's drainage system.
improvisation_points: Get the coordinates for the lost cores from Byte-Thief.
Locate the cores in the server racks guarded by Cold-Frame.
Bypass the security locks with Gate-Keeper's authorization.

quests.title: Signal Disharmony
quests.narrative_guidance: Interrupt the station's internal broadcasts to mask a secret delivery.
improvisation_points: Obtain the frequency jammer from Pulse-Echo.
Install the jammer in the vent paths managed by Slyn Vent.
Ensure the final signal is sealed by Riko Gasket.

quests.title: The Hydroponic Harvest
quests.narrative_guidance: Collect rare bioluminescent spores to power an experimental light source.
improvisation_points: Collect the spores from Vora Spore in the gardens.
Have Dredge Gasket purify the spores for transport.
Deliver the refined material to Vane Thorne for inspection.

quests.title: Mercenary Contract
quests.narrative_guidance: Eliminate the paper trail of a rival mercenary crew.
improvisation_points: Receive the target list from Kaelen Voss at the Terrace.
Acquire the access codes from Rinn Scry in the Valve Hall.
Finalize the contract termination with Sila Grave at the Pub.
